Admin.explanation: Admins open the console and review pending verifications. AdminService aggregates via $queryRaw, then reviewVerification toggles verificationStatus on the provider or volunteer profile and writes an AuditLog in the same transaction, only then notifying the profile owner. Admins create accounts and campaigns directly, lock/unlock users, assign volunteers to campaigns and review change requests. Locking an account revokes every RefreshToken for that user - which is why User is composed with RefreshToken. Every action leaves an AuditLog row attributing the actor. Food catalog CRUD, report moderation and system configuration. A category composes its items, so deleting a category deletes its items as well. SystemConfigService is the single source for runtime-tunable business parameters (daily quota, search radius, QR validity) that other modules read on each call.
